name: 04-xiaohe
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE distinctive finished logo symbol for 禾观 / AgriScan, a Chinese crop-health observation app whose personality is warm, curious, dependable and close to the fields. Important feedback: an elaborate eye surrounding a leaf felt too corporate and complex, but plain sprout/leaf/field pictograms felt far too simple and generic. Aim for a carefully designed middle ground: a memorable compact emblem with 5–8 intentional graphic elements and a clever visual idea. Rich enough to feel authored, restrained enough to read as a logo. Flat clean graphic design, softly rounded shapes, a hint of contemporary editorial illustration and handmade charm. Forest green, gentle sage and at most one warm grain-gold accent on solid warm ivory. No gradients, no shading, no 3D, no texture, no corporate swooshes, no shield, no tech circuits, no crosshair, no watermark, no presentation mockups, no sheets of variants. No text or lettering. One symbol centered at a generous scale on a square canvas. Direction A, 小禾的好奇心: create a unique friendly little botanical companion as a compact logo, inspired by a seed rather than a generic robot. A softly rounded ivory seed-shaped face outlined with a substantial forest green contour, two expressive tiny green eyes, two unequal green leaves sprouting from its head. At its lower right, ONE small circular magnifying lens is held close to ONE leaf, conveying curiosity. Let the face contour, leaf and lens interlock into a single tidy balanced silhouette. The lens has a simple warm gold ring and a short green handle. Head-and-gesture only, no full body, no arms with fingers, no extra props. Aim for an endearing mature indie-app mascot emblem, not babyish clip art. Carefully proportioned facial features, subtly tilted curious expression. Very limited interior detail.
